user.title: CPAP Local Setup
user.description: Choose how to connect to your CPAP device's SD card.

http.title: HTTP Connection
http.description: Connect via a WiFi SD card adapter (e.g. EZ Share). Your CPAP device must be off and the adapter powered up.

local.title: Local Path
local.description: Connect to a locally mounted SD card or network share.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device. Make sure your CPAP is off and your device is connected to its WiFi network. Submit again to save anyway.
error.invalid_path: The specified path does not exist or is not a directory.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See Home Assistant logs for details.
